name: Sentinel
source:
One month ’till Christmas Day. Students at Shigure High School are excited about it. Toru is also looking forward to it. But there is one thing that worries him: a girl who appears in his dreams. One night, the girl in his dream asks him, “Do you want to change your memories?” He recalls his childhood – he had lost his parents, and had decided to live with his younger sister. “Shall I change your memories?” Her mysterious offer turns into reality…

translation:
距离圣诞节还有一个月。时雨学园的学生们都为此兴奋不已，彻也满怀期待。但有一件事令他不安：梦中反复出现的一名女孩。一天夜里，梦中的女孩问他：“你想改变自己的记忆吗？”他回想起童年——父母已经去世，他决定与妹妹相依为命。“要我改变你的记忆吗？”她神秘的提议化为了现实……
